name: mgamadeus/ddd-agents
description: The agentic loop for mgamadeus/ddd: conversations, messages, compaction, the task plan, skills and MCP metadata, purposes and criteria, widgets and signal sources, delegation, the supervisor and run claims

suggest.php-tui/php-tui: Draws the full-screen agent chat (app:agent:chat-tui); without it the command ends with a line naming the library
suggest.ratchet/pawl: The WebSocket client of the voice session worker, which stays with a call from its answer to its end; without it the voice channel reads as unavailable and app:agent:check-installation names a switched-on AI.agentVoice.enabled
suggest.react/event-loop: The event loop the voice session worker runs its WebSocket connection and its timers on; needed together with ratchet/pawl by an application that switches the voice channel on
